Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. The draw acts on ordinal rank after typed election; it is not a probability
distribution over the evidence fields. candidate_can_output excludes geometry-only
evidence, naming-only channels and contract metadata from direct semantic output. Full
obligation closure and sharing/summary comparators remain nested helpers.
